description: Advanced level only (every plan and the free trial). Every field is optional; missing fields keep their value. copy_mode: proportional (default; copies follow the leader's size) or fixed (a margin per position, whatever the leader's size, Unified Account only; not_unified skip otherwise), one at a time; settings of the other mode stay saved, without effect, and open copies keep the rule they opened with. Fixed mode: fixed_margin_pct (margin per position, in % of equity at entry), fixed_leverage (capped at the market's maximum), fixed_positions (positions at once; fixed_positions × fixed_margin_pct can't exceed 100). Value of a position = margin × leverage. Adds are ignored, reductions and closes followed; when every slot is taken the trade is skipped and not picked up later. Isolated-only markets are skipped. tp_sl_basis: pnl (default) or price, for tp1_pct, tp2_pct, sl_pct: pnl = PnL % of the copy, leverage included; price = % of price from the copy's average price (0.1 to 90). account_tp_pct: when the whole account, manual positions included, deposits and withdrawals excluded, gains this % since its base, close account_tp_close_pct (25, 50, 75 or 100) of every copy at market, once; checked every 5 minutes, it can run past the target; re-arms when no copy is open; event account_tp. Proportional mode: size_pct: size of your copies in % of your leaders' size across 3 leaders (100 = risque). max_exposure_x: total exposure cap in x your balance, or null for none. max_open_positions: integer, or null for no limit. alerts_pct: one or two increasing drawdown thresholds. auto_stop_pct: drawdown from your highest balance at which every copy is closed and copying pauses, or null. follow_adds, copy_leader_tpsl: booleans. markets: which markets new copies may open on, any of crypto (Hyperliquid's main perps), btc (BTC only), xyz (every tokenized stock, index and commodity), gold (xyz:GOLD), wti (xyz:CL), indexes (xyz:SP500, xyz:XYZ100, xyz:JP225, xyz:KR200), combined with OR; [] = all markets (default). min_market_leverage: copy only markets whose Hyperliquid max leverage is at least this (AND with markets), or null. max_leverage: cap on the leverage set on your copies (margin used, not copy size), or null. sides: both (default), long or short, for new copies; adds, reductions and closes of open copies are always followed. copy_stop_pct: your own stop on each new copy at entry -/+ this %, or null; the leader's copied stop is kept when it is closer. daily_loss_pct: when your balance, deposits and withdrawals of the day excluded, falls this % below its first reading of the UTC day, no new copies for 24 hours (event daily_loss_limit), or null. Trades not copied by these rules are skipped with codes market_filtered, leverage_filtered, side_filtered, daily_loss_limit. You are on your own. tp1_pct / tp1_close_pct, tp2_pct / tp2_close_pct, sl_pct / sl_close_pct: your own take profits and stop loss on each new copy, at a PnL % of the copy (leverage included, as Hyperliquid shows it: at 10x, 20 = 2% price) and the % of the copy to close (tp2: of what is left; 100 = all), or null; break_even_after_tp1: after take profit 1, move the stop to break-even. After a partial close the copy keeps following the leader on what is left.
